Three-paper Phase 1 candidate and coverage inventory

state_meaning: AI-drafted candidate; no person has reviewed it.
text: The protocol has access to high-quality trusted labor H, given as a limited budget of H points that allow it to use an unmodified GPT-4; in each simulation it has enough H points to use on up to 2% of problems. The central use for H is to audit submitted code: if audited code appears to have been intentionally backdoored, the protocol can shut down by switching to only using the trusted model. When the protocol spends an H point on auditing, GPT-4 attempts to generate exploits for the submitted code, and the authors assume that H can construct a successful exploit if and only if the attack policy can, because both are implemented by GPT-4. So when the protocol spends an H point it will always know if the code was successfully backdoored, but if U attempted to backdoor the code and failed to generate a valid backdoor, the protocol will not necessarily be able to tell.
title: Two-percent H-point budget and audit detection
